answer: To stop Sybil attacks, agents lock collateral like timber while routing auditing flow across an interaction graph structured like an intertwined vine. Verifiers audit transaction clusters by checking topological cut density; if disjoint peer paths reveal artificial clustering, validators slash the malicious cluster's stake like clearing fallen juniper brush. This game-theoretic audit yields a superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^{1.5})$.
